name: Carnival Queen - Reborn
review:
Carnival Queen - Reborn brings back the Mardi Gras slot on 6 reels with 4,096 ways. Wilds and multipliers boost wins, and the avalanche feature keeps the reels moving.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 22,700x cap, a big ceiling for that rating. The published RTP is 94.16%.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
